ck.story.1.text: In Rumble's cozy kitchen, a big batch of cookies is baking for a party!

ck.story.2.text: Knock, knock! Here come the friends. Hello, Bobbo, Gloop and Zuzu!

ck.story.3.text: Uh-oh! Everyone wants cookies. Each friend must get the same, so it's fair.

ck.story.4.text: Hoo-hoo! I'm Hoot. Let's share the cookies fairly, plate by plate!

ck.story.mid1.text: Mmm! The kitchen smells so sweet. More friends are hungry!

ck.story.mid2.text: Halfway there! The party table is filling up.

ck.story.mid3.text: Just a few more plates to share!

ck.story.end1.text: The party is ready! Every friend has a fair share of cookies.

ck.story.end2.text: Hoo-hoo! You gave one to each plate, again and again. That's fair sharing!

ck.story.end3.text: You earned a Brain Spark! Next time, even more friends are coming!

ck.help.explain.text: Fair sharing means every plate gets the same. Give one to each plate, then go around again!

ck.help.hint.text: Hoo! Let's check. Deal one cookie to each plate, round and round. Then count one plate.

ck.praise.2.text: Every plate got {n}. That's fair sharing!

ck.praise.3.text: You worked out the fair share. {n} each!

ck.praise.4.text: Fair and square! {n} on every plate!

ck.hint.deal.text: Hmm, that's not fair yet. Let's deal them out, one each, round and round.

ck.hint.model.text: Let's share them together. One for each plate, then around again.

ck.idle.text: Drag a cookie onto a plate. Give one to each friend!

ck.fair.text: Every plate has the same. That's fair! How many each?

ck.unfair.text: Hmm, some plates have more. Is that fair? Move a cookie!
